packageRules.description: Python is on 3.12 deliberately (requires-python >=3.12). Patch bumps only; a new minor is a decision, not a PR.
The openclaw npm version is pinned in the goplaces-node Dockerfile and the compose build arg. Bump both in one PR so they stay in sync.
